title: Live stress solver, integrity fixpoint, and a readable scene
summary: Three fixes in one pass: (1) integrity fixpoint — the support solver now re-runs after every destruction (blasts AND timer crumbles) with a doomed-set dedup, so nothing can hang in the air waiting for a second click; (2) live stress solver — loads propagate down the BFS load tree and concentrate where paths converge (capacity 300, calibrated so the intact monument idles at ~23% while a lone surviving pillar spikes past 80% and shimmers ember); x-ray heat visibly reroutes over ~1s after each shot, peak-stress chip in the HUD, overload glow telegraphs weak points; (3) brightness — hemisphere+ambient fill, ACES tone mapping, lifted fog/ground/palette/stage CSS. Collapse cam now engages from the crumble chain too (keyed on doomedSet.size, 2600ms window) and the per-frame color repaint was cut to overloaded-only after full-mesh shimmer starved software-rendered mobile. Verified: tsc clean; 60+ headless checks green at 1440/1024/390 incl. new pillar-reroute (23->100%), settle-stability, engagement-counter checks.

title: Golden Hour Ruin pass: bright aspect-aware renderer, mobile framing, card copy
summary: Owner verdict handled on three fronts. (1) Page redesigned to the chat-model's locked 'Golden Hour Ruin' spec: opaque procedural golden sky (alpha:false), warm lights + exposure 1.30, lighter scoped page palette with dark HUD ink over the sky; new copy ('Raze the district'). Fixed the actual darkness disease: MeshStandardMaterial had vertexColors:true with no geometry color attribute, multiplying instance colors to near-black silhouettes. (2) Mobile: level aspect-aware camera (distance = clamp(27.475/aspect, 22.5, 46), targetY = 0.25478*distance) frames the full 16.6-wide district on a 390px portrait stage; blast FX now site at the district plane instead of a hardcoded 12 units. (3) Card copy names the Rust→WebAssembly core (keeps test-pinned 'voxel monument' + tag physics). Browser suite re-anchored to world-space projection aims through the locked framing; root-caused two suite flakes: shell scroll-behavior:smooth made rect reads stale (force instant scroll), and boundary-exact aims graze THREE raycaster boxes while the DDA hits (aim at voxel-cell centers). Collapse assert recalibrated to the robust browser contract (>=3% reshape + collapse-cam engagements; ffi-smoke.mjs still owns core cascade semantics). Full suite green on desktop-1440/tablet-1024/mobile-390 + landing copy; typecheck + build green.
